end.parentNote: Harsh practised taking the horizontal x-coordinate first and then the vertical y-coordinate, and identifying quadrants from coordinate signs. They correctly explained that (3,2) and (2,3) are different points because the movement order changes. They first mixed up the quadrant after changing a negative x-coordinate, then corrected it to Quadrant IV later in the lesson. At home, ask them to plot three ordered pairs and describe the horizontal and vertical movements aloud.
